summary: Tested the registrar-first excuse workflow end to end: backend pytest (21 tests) plus Playwright UI runs as registrar, dean and dept head. The new behaviour works. Every excuse type (exam/family/official/sick, from the web or the mobile /api/absence-excuses endpoint) lands at route=registration. The registrar gets both the decide block and the forward block (se-decide + se-forward). He can decide an exam-type excuse himself. Forward to board or dean works (invalid target returns 400, a second forward returns 403). After forwarding, the row stays in the registrar's list with the se-row-forwarded badge and the se-detail-forwarded field. The dean can decide only after forwarding: on a registration-route item his decide and forward calls return 403, and approving a board item without a session number/date returns 400. After the dean approved, the registrar saw the item as معتمد with the board session number. The mobile /my response has a 'forwarded' boolean that turns true after forwarding. Faculty/department scoping is fixed for the default list, get, decide, forward and student search: Saeed (dept head) now sees only his own department's items, read-only. ONE SECURITY BUG: the optional faculty_id / department_id query params on GET /api/student-excuses overwrite the user's scope filter instead of being combined with it, so any registrar, dean or dept head can list other faculties' and departments' excuses. Backend 19/21 pass; the 2 failures are this bug.

critical.issue: Scope bypass. In list_excuses(), lines 447-450 run `if faculty_id: f['faculty_id'] = faculty_id` and `if department_id: f['department_id'] = department_id` AFTER the role-scope filter, so they replace it. Reproduced: test_registrar (sharia faculty) with ?faculty_id=698e4fb497fef774e66e93a6 got a girls-faculty excuse; Saeed (dept head) with ?department_id=698e500997fef774e66e93a8 got the sharia department's excuses. The pending_by_route counts leak the same way because they reuse the same filter. Fix: for non-admin users, keep the scope and only narrow it, e.g. if faculty_id is not in the user's faculty ids use an empty match (or return 403).

minor.issue: ref_no is built as count_documents({})+1. It produces duplicate ref numbers once any document is deleted, and when two requests are created at the same time. This already happened in this session: SE-2026-0002 and SE-2026-0003 were reused. Use an atomic counter collection instead.
A dean/registrar with no faculty_id (`not fids`) sees and can act on every faculty. This may be intended for university-wide registration managers; confirm it is.

issues: The active filter tab uses background #0f2440, the same colour as the page header bar. The selected tab (e.g. 'الكل') therefore looks like plain text with no button, so the active state is not visible.
Dates (se-form-from, se-form-to, se-board-date) use the browser's native input type=date (mm/dd/yyyy, in English) instead of an RTL/Arabic date picker component.
The fallback subtitle (shown only when meta.rule is missing) still describes the old routing ('تُوجَّه حسب النوع والمدة'). The header comment on line 1 of student_excuses.py is also stale.
In RTL the '↳' glyph renders mirrored/odd at the end of the line; consider a plain Arabic label or an RTL-friendly arrow.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the scope bypass in list_excuses(): faculty_id/department_id query params must narrow, not replace, the non-admin scope filter (faculty_id at line 447, department_id at line 450). Also apply this to the pending_by_route aggregation.

Update or retire the legacy /app/backend/tests/test_student_excuses_flow.py. It still asserts the old auto-routing (family 2 days -> dean, official -> board, exam -> board), so it now fails. Its cleanup also runs an UNFILTERED `db.notifications.delete_many({'type': 'student_excuse'})`, which wipes real users' excuse notifications. Change it to delete only the notification ids it created.
Replace count-based ref_no generation with an atomic counter.
Make the active filter tab distinguishable from the header background; update the stale fallback subtitle.
critical_code_review_comments: student_excuses.py list_excuses(): the user-supplied faculty_id/department_id params override the role scope (security bug, see above).

_reviewer_ids() also notifies users with no faculty (faculty_id None/'' and no faculty_ids) for every faculty. That is fine for a central registration manager, but registrars with no faculty will get notified for every faculty's requests.
forward_excuse() takes the raw request.json() with no Pydantic model. The `to` value is validated manually, but a Pydantic body would be more consistent.

A forwarded request that the dean puts into needs_info returns to pending on the same route (dean/board) when the student adds attachments, so it does not go back to the registrar. This seems correct, but confirm it is intended.

success_rate.backend: 90% (19/21; the 2 failures are the same scope-bypass bug)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (registrar submit+forward, badge/detail, dean board approve, registrar sees outcome, dept-head scoped read-only view, submit hint text)

All were deleted by id afterwards; only the pre-existing SE-2026-0001 (6aef573781ca6d060ce1d1b6) remains. Any existing student_excuse notifications in the DB were therefore removed. This is a data defect caused by that legacy script.
